Multiplayer and feature limits

Play together on your local network, then check the limits that still apply.

Updated 5 November 2026 · 3 min read · Everyone · feature ledger · all guides

Multiplayer

Good to know. Use the same game build on both computers and a trusted local network. Multiplayer still has limits; it is not complete parity with solo play. Join a multiplayer world Multiplayer menu: Host this world (LAN hosting)

Host your world

  1. Open Multiplayer on the main menu and choose Host this world.
  2. Read the join address shown. Other players can choose your world from their LAN list, or type that complete address and port into SERVER. Multiplayer menu: list of worlds hosted on the LAN
  3. Keep the host computer on and connected. Opening Main menu keeps hosting.
  4. Choose Stop hosting to disconnect other players and return to solo play with the recovered world and pack. If the initial save fails, hosting continues; fix the reported problem and try again.

If hosting has stopped but pack recovery fails, keep the game open. Continue returns to the repair session, F6 retries, and Shift+F6 opens a recovery choice. Follow Saves and world files before discarding any state.

Join a world

  1. Open Multiplayer. Choose a LAN world or one of your last eight servers, or type HOST or HOST:PORT in SERVER. The default port is 27015.
  2. Enter your display name in NAME; leave it empty to use your login name. Tab switches fields.
  3. Choose Join server or press Enter. Esc cancels while joining. Your local world is saved before joining; the server world is kept by its host.

Each player has a separate inventory. Supported crafting, chest transfers, Survival needs and recovery wait for the server. Boats and some other actions remain limited. A refusal message explains when an action is unavailable.

Press Enter to type a chat message, Enter again to send it, or Esc to cancel. Multiplayer chat

Careful. The first server certificate is remembered. If it changes, joining is refused; check the server identity before changing saved trust.

For the separate server program and console commands, see Run a dedicated server (voxelgame-server).

Fire

Planned, not in the game. There is no fire you can light, spread or put out. Explosions show a brief flash and burst and leave nothing burning. Fire

The FIRE & FOOD crafting tab holds recipes only: charcoal, cooked meat, glass and flasks are made instantly there, with no campfire or furnace to place. Charcoal, cooking and glass (no furnace)

Planned, not in the game. Campfires, furnaces and spreading fire are not in the game yet.

Lava

Planned, not in the game. There is no lava liquid. Volcanic areas and lava tubes are solid rock: basalt, obsidian, lava rock, pahoehoe and magma stone. Lava tubes are cooled and walkable. Nothing flows, burns or cools into stone. Lava
Good to know. Only water flows in this version, so there is no lava pool to avoid.

Waterfalls and dripstone

Planned, not in the game. There are no natural waterfalls, stalactites, stalagmites or dripstone caves. Water you place in creative mode can pour over an edge, but no cascade is drawn and the waterfall sound is not used. Natural waterfalls and dripstone caves

Furniture that is still missing

Planned, not in the game. Beds, closets and extendable tables are not in this version. Tables currently have a fixed size.

Chairs, stools, benches, armchairs, sofas, kitchen units and bathroom fixtures are available. Use the furniture plans in the Building guide. Survival carpentry needs a carried Furniture hammer. Furniture and carpentry

Wooden chests and doors are also available; see Wooden chests and Wooden doors. Basins and bathtubs do not create or store water, and plumbing is still absent.

Player skins

Planned, not in the game. Your explorer wears one built-in outfit with fixed colours. There is no skin editor, and no skin import or export. Player skins and skin editor

When a feature ships

A feature moves off this page only after the game ships it and its source is checked. Its own guide then replaces the entry here.

How this guide was checked

Each item comes from the feature ledger, which cites the game source for the audited version. The absence checks searched the source for block, recipe and gameplay names. Fire, lava, waterfall, dripstone and fixed explorer colours were spot-checked again at game commit ddc0042. Furniture availability and remaining bed/closet/extendable-table gaps were source-checked on 5 November 2026 at Voxelgame aa136e0103ce5599c6d8a9f70c669dbc758b7357 (crates/voxelgame-core/src/furniture/definition.rs:18-97; game/furniture/catalog.rs:43-76; game/furniture/workbench.rs:97-116). This is a targeted correction, not a new check of the other missing-feature sections. Multiplayer follow-up at aa136e0103ce5599c6d8a9f70c669dbc758b7357: source-checked hosted save/refusal, F6 retry, Shift+F6 recovery choice, server-owned stock/crafting and Survival recovery. Preserve the separate furniture helper’s verification additions.

Initial ledger audit: Voxelgame main dd29d91, committed 10 October 2026; article updated 5 November 2026. Source-checked, not play-tested. This page says what is missing, not how the planned features will work. Recheck it when a listed feature ships. No new native host/join, two-computer LAN, fault-injection or gameplay capture in this multiplayer follow-up.
